logic_upgrades.description: Treat explicit stronger/weaker currency wording as already-observed price context, with the correct currency sign, never as a new policy forecast.
A pre-move news success now requires a timely and directionally publishable event; retrospective and research-only rows remain diagnostic only.
Recovered 132,737 missing M1 rows across all 68 practice pairs so rolling quote retention cannot erase this week's audit evidence.
Parse source-native actual, prior, consensus and components; abstain when causal surprise is missing.
Bind fiscal and central-bank semantics to timestamped yield or policy-path repricing before choosing currency direction.
A fast official-source watch may open inert 1/5/15/30/60/120-minute price-response arms even when initial semantic direction is unresolved.
Use event-family response horizons; do not let generic 30-minute media windows hide a valid slower official-macro factor.
Measure movement already completed before first-seen time and require remaining expected magnitude to clear executable cost.
Rank all observed currency legs from the exact 68-pair response rather than inferring a broad factor from one pair.
Retain major after-cost moves with no causal source as explicit residual research cases instead of forcing a headline attribution.
